SELECT A.SEQNO SEQNO, A.CREDIT_MST_ID creditMstId, A.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, A.TERM TERM, A.PFLSH PFLSH, A.PFLSH_NAME pflshName, A.CREDIT_AMT/100000000 creditAmt, A.VDATE VDATE, A.MDATE MDATE, A.CREDIT_FLAG as creditFlag, A.REMARK, A.CREDIT_CONDITION
,A.CREDIT_OBJ as creditObj ,A.CREDIT_AMT/100000000 as creditShareAmt
,A.APPR_VDATE ,A.APPR_MDATE
,A.CREDIT_VDATE as creditVdate ,A.CREDIT_MDATE as creditMdate ,A.IS_LOOP_AMT as isLoopAmt
,A.HOLD_MATURITY as holdMaturity ,A.CREDIT_PRICE as creditPrice FROM CREDIT_LINES A where SEQNO = #{seqno,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT a.FINPROD_ID id, CONCAT(a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,CONCAT(':' ,a.FINPROD_ABBR)) text ,a.FINPROD_TYPE2 ,a.PROFIT_TYPE ,b.TYPE_9 ,b.TYPE_10
FROM FIN_PRODUCT a inner join fin_product_type b on a.finprod_id=b.finprod_id
b.TYPE_8 is not null
AND (a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%', #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR a.FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%', #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') )
AND a.FINPROD_ID = #{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM FIN_PRODUCT fp WHERE fp.FINPROD_ID = a.FINPROD_ID AND fp.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F17' AND fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F17' AND fp.P_FINPROD_ID IS NOT NULL )

SELECT m.CUSTOMER_ID as customerId, n.ASSETPOOL_NAME as customerName FROM CREDIT_LINES m left join CREDIT_ASSETPOOL n on m.CUSTOMER_ID=n.SEQNO where m.CUSTOMER_ID in (select SEQNO from CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL where FINPROD_ID=#{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
